verdicts.reason: Both are nearly identical cramped banners. The tiny white body copy sits on the far left, ahead of the headline, so the reading order is reversed. The pink subhead is squeezed into a narrow right column of 7–8 lines of illegible micro-type, and the URL under the PlayStation-style symbols is unreadable. A's right column wraps worse, with near-orphan lines like 'AND YOU' and 'CANNOT' crowding the top and bottom edges. B wraps a little more evenly, but it still has every structural flaw A has.
